from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class HousingReportRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single month's housing construction data extracted from one release report."""
    month: str | None = Field(description="The data month in YYYY-MM format")
    report_date: str | None = Field(description="The release date of this report in YYYY-MM-DD format to determine precedence")
    single_family_units: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally adjusted count for '1 unit' (single-family) in thousands")
    five_or_more_units: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally adjusted count for '5 units or more' (multi-family) in thousands")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the counts, e.g., 'thousands'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    monthly_housing_records: list[HousingReportRecord]
